summary: Certified when the self-application charge convicts: only against stated rules in the same epistemic sense, with a witnessed consistent critic that keeps an epistemic demand and a brute root. Rejected: reading a brute root as breaching an epistemic demand (equivocation; the critic model separates them); treating the supported-implies-explained bridge as an independent premise (under support coverage it gives the PSR, and it follows from the PSR, so it is the PSR over supported facts); a uniformity test alone as settling a boundary (any status can be made its own feature, and one stance is selective and restricted relative to different features); a boundary defined by having a reason (it holds in every arena). Tested and not defended: the evidence bridge leaves a brute truth that is never used as evidence; the global-defeat conditional gives no accessible brute truth from any support, but it is undefended and the rival who holds defeat is local denies it. Blocker: no argument for global defeat over local defeat is certified, and no narrowest-bridge claim is made beyond the tested forms. Not read: Koons-Pruss, Pruss, Della Rocca and their critics (#409), so nothing is attributed to them; the comparison of their defenses in #756 task 3 remains open. Not imported as lemmas: #698, #737/#739, #746, #750. See docs/notes/psr-self-application-756.md. Scope-specific follow-up2026-11-01 for owner transcendental analogy and tentative C_PC: inspect existing PSRSelfApplication.stanceMap/bridgeLadder, generic Norm.selfApplication, ExplanatoryAdequacy.forced/core, NecessaryFactBoundary.lawControl and current selected actual causal-coverage definition. No new source reading/claim or theorem. Same-sense retorsion remains positive: an accepted claim within an epistemic demand cannot simultaneously fail that demand while the norm is honored. The critic model separates epistemic support from ontic explanation, but its Arena uses Being=Empty; do NOT advertise it as a concrete countermodel to C_PC. The meaningful-assertion analogy can establish commitment to determinate presentation or epistemic entitlement only with its explicit performance/scope interpretation; it does not itself quantify over every unasserted contingent existence-fact. Even SupportCoverage plus TrackingBridge reaches fact-level ContingentPSR, not concrete complete production, and bridgeLadder shows tracking under coverage reproduces that disputed PSR scope. EvidenceBridge covers facts USED as evidence only; a mere supported ontic brute root can remain outside it. GlobalDefeat would exclude brute facts from any support, but its global-versus-local force is an extra open premise, not derived from speaking rationally. For C_PC two further transfers are explicit: first actual accepted/investigated epistemic claims to ALL actual contingent existence-facts with ontic explanatory tracking; second fact reasons to actual CONCRETE COMPLETE producers of the SAME bearers under the same selected Ontic. Arena.exist is data; Coherent supplies its existence-truth interpretation. Arena.explains does not equal Ontic.Causes, and no reason token is automatically an actually existing concrete producer. Necessary fact/account results do not close that gap. ExplanatoryAdequacy.ReasonClosed.covered ALREADY assumes contingent reason coverage and Founded is separately retained, so applying the incompatible core is not deriving those premises by retorsion. Owner D1 global insufficiency of wholly derivative explanations remains retained; no consistent epistemic or infinite graph is awarded adequate explanation of the totality by this audit. Likewise refusal to offer an adequate ontic explanation is not, without a same-sense premise, a contradiction in an epistemic demand. The concrete remaining test is reality/complete-production correspondence for the selected existence explanandum, or explicit conditional adoption of C_PC; no opaque epistemic-to-C_PC bridge, new primitive truth acceptance or root discharge is introduced. Existing docs/notes/psr-self-application-756.md already preserve later Della Rocca/Kleinschmidt first-principle/source investigations; the original not-read statement above belongs to the earlier implementation phase and is not a current claim that those later recorded readings never occurred.
